An '''acid spider''' was a dangerous type of [[Spider/Legends|spider]] that existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. [[Lanoree Brock]] once woke from a [[Dream/Legends|dream]] on Tython and thought of the dangerous wildlife in the foothills of [[Talss]], such as these spiders and [[flame tygah]]s, but she knew that she would [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] them through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] if they came close and thus was not worried.<ref name="Into the Void" />
